title: setTimeout, setImmediate, queueMicrotask, and process.nextTick
hook: Not all async scheduling is equal: process.nextTick runs before Promise microtasks in Node, setTimeout is a macrotask, and queueMicrotask is explicit microtask — mixing them wrong breaks test ordering and deferral assumptions.

blocks.text: **setTimeout(fn, ms)**: macrotask (timer phase in Node). **setImmediate(fn)**: macrotask after I/O callbacks (Node). **queueMicrotask(fn)**: microtask queue — same as Promise.then. **process.nextTick(fn)**: Node-only, runs **before** other microtasks — highest priority after sync code.

entries.plainDefinition: Task queue item — one per loop turn after microtasks.
Node microtask queue with higher priority than Promise.

blocks.text: Legacy Node code uses nextTick to defer — starves I/O if recursive. Tests assuming setTimeout(0) before Promise.then fail in Node. Deferring Redis callback with wrong queue causes race with await continuation.

blocks.title: Prefer queueMicrotask
blocks.body: In cross-platform code use queueMicrotask not nextTick — works in browser and Node.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Uses nextTick in browser. Cannot order nextTick vs Promise. Recursive nextTick unaware.

interviewTakeaways: 60s: Sync, nextTick drain, microtasks drain, one macrotask. Browser lacks nextTick. queueMicrotask portable. Recursive nextTick starves I/O.
